Both pathways involve enzymes or transporters that modulate the activity of Thrombopoietin, though the exact mechanism by which these intermediaries influence Thrombopoietin remains unclear. The scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, but the evidence is not fully conclusive.
